anonymization.accounts: Display labels use work-account/personal-account; identifier keys use work_account/personal_account.
anonymization.paths: Evidence paths are relative to the repository root; .. retains locations outside it. Historical commands anchor external paths at ${PWD}. Evidence was not copied or moved.
anonymization.history: Original timestamps, hashes, results and caveats are retained. Labels and paths are anonymized representations; historical verification does not attest to edited bytes or current live state.

scope: Approved option 4: one bottom startup bar per MindPlayer process, with downstream Native/Jev session and turn UI

behavior.startup: Existing scope picker and scan, then a read-only real session list with the approved bottom startup bar
behavior.initialSelection: Native, unconfirmed; no mode restored from a previous process
behavior.choiceControls: Arrow keys choose, Enter confirms, Esc/q exits; modified keys cannot accidentally authorize
behavior.jevConsentControls: After local readiness, c explicitly toggles external-transfer consent, then Enter starts; Esc returns to choice
behavior.beforeConfirmation: Keyboard, paste, mouse and background-resume paths cannot spawn a PTY
behavior.native: Original CLI/account/cwd/permissions/model/effort; dedicated routing secrets stripped; no Jev assets, key, Node readiness or private UI dependency
behavior.jev: Bounded asynchronous local-only prerequisites check, then separate external-transfer consent; no API request or model probe during readiness
behavior.localReadinessFailure: Fixed safe reason, no silent Native fallback and no automatic retry/replay
behavior.modeScope: All new launches and resumptions in this process, including new-account login, handoff, multi-select and background-resume paths
behavior.reattach: Existing pane PID, draft and effective running mode preserved; no chooser or hot switching
behavior.modeDisplay: Read-only CLI 그대로 or Jev 사용 (Codex) in list/live headers
behavior.providerScope: Codex routing only; Claude/Kiro/Cursor retain the original CLI in either startup mode
behavior.turnUi: Existing judgment, model-plus-effort request, acknowledgement, actual start, completion, follow-up, interrupted/error and independent queued-input lifecycle plus Trace
